definition: Autognostics is a new paradigm that describes the capacity for computer networks to be self-aware.
details: It is considered one of the major components of Autonomic Networking.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. Boil it down and it is this: Autognostics is a new paradigm that describes the capacity for computer networks to be self-aware. Here is why it matters: It is considered one of the major components of Autonomic Networking. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Autognostics.
